title: Individual return preparation
general_guidance: Written from the preparer's side. Derived from four past returns; the home office method and the documentation threshold varied with the client's records.

rules.guidance: Check the client's records before choosing a method.
rules.escalation: Escalate to the reviewing partner when the office is also used for personal purposes.

positions.text: Use the simplified method at $5 per square foot, up to 300 square feet.
Use the regular method with actual expenses allocated by floor area.
positions.conditions: The client has complete utility and rent records for the year.

positions.text: Claim a home office for a space that is also used for personal purposes.
Require a written acknowledgment for each single gift of $250 or more before deducting it.
